name: Sugao no Hohoemi
source:
During summer vacation main character goes to the pool with a shy childhood friend Miwa and her cheerful friend Yui. And Miwa suddenly collapses there. Woman Kizuha runs up, and it triggers a series of strange events...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
暑假期间，主人公和害羞的儿时好友美和，以及她开朗的朋友由依一起去了泳池。美和突然在那里倒下。女性木津叶跑上前去，这触发了一连串奇怪事件……

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
